title: John S Probable NDE 4449
content: I went bowling and pulled a muscle in my back. I was admitted to a local hospital for pain control. They ended up over-medicating me and I was left alone. I vomited and aspirated on the vomit. I was sent emergency to a bigger hospital. I developed adult respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and then sepsis. They put me on a ventilator and into a medically induced coma. I was near death, but not officially dead. I knew I was dying and was fighting to stay alive. I remember just feeling tired of fighting. I was half out of it all the time, I guess due to the medicine to keep me in a coma. All of a sudden, my alertness was greatly heightened and I was on an elevator going up. The doors opened and there were some people there. I didn't know them but I had a certainty that one of them was a relative of mine; he was in charge of my entire family line. There was another person there that was a person in charge. I was given the choice to stay on earth and live, or the suffering could end and I could go to a very comfortable, pain free, place. I thought about my children left without a father and profound sadness settled over me, as I knew that I would have to come back if it was up to me. All of this happened with no words, it was just thoughts that contained communication. I knew that all I had to do was step off the elevator and everything would end in this world and begin the next chapter of my existence. Nothing about the experience was religious at all. It was very peaceful. I didn't step off the elevator and came back to my body. I was very sad to leave what was offered to me but I had to try to take care of my kids. Anyway, that is my experience. I am not religious at all - I was a little bit before this happened, but after this experience, I knew without a doubt that there was something for us after this life. I also knew it had nothing to do with traditional religion. There was no deity, no judging this life or anything like this. I had the sense and knowledge that this life is just a phase or segment of our overall existence. This life was presented to me as a chapter in the book of what is our life or existence.

arrival.other_being_detail: He reported unknown people present; he had certainty one was a relative and was 'in charge of my entire family line,' and 'another person there that was a person in charge.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Over-medication in hospital led to vomiting and aspiration; developed ARDS and then sepsis; ventilator and medically induced coma.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Not religious (reported being 'a little bit' religious before).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Elevator going up; offered choice to stay on earth or go to a comfortable, pain-free place.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Heightened alertness while in coma, then elevator ascent, then encounter with people and a choice at the elevator threshold, then return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Transitional movement described as riding an elevator upward; one person was perceived as a relative 'in charge of my entire family line.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I knew that all I had to do was step off the elevator and everything would end in this world and begin the next chapter of my existence.”
